correctness.rationale: PASS: Ind_2(H) is a simplicial complex on the 14 Fano incidence vertices defined by induced maximum degree<=1 (equivalently all induced components have at most two vertices). Fresh independent enumeration of all 2^14 subsets gives f-vector with empty face (1,14,91,322,651,728,392,58), total 2,257. Sequential vertex-matching with modified empty-face pair leaves 1,121 disjoint nonempty matched pairs and critical cells exactly one vertex plus thirteen six-vertex faces; independent full directed-Hasse topological sort verifies acyclicity on all 2,256 nonempty faces and 10,150 arrows. Forman discrete Morse gives a CW model with one zero-cell and thirteen 5-cells, so every attaching map is constant and the integral homotopy type is wedge^13 S5. This complete finite certificate proves the fixed natural graph; mere mod-two Betti ranks would not prove the integral wedge.
